sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: Class C privilege, application requirements, proof documents, insurance and collision duties
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
Application fees are not printed in these pages; the manual sends applicants to the DMV website, so no fee is taught [A01].
The hearing designation symbol does not survive text extraction, so only the words printed on the back of the card are taught; the donor registry phone number and website are not taught [A04].
The loss of privileges list is marked by the manual itself as incomplete; only the listed reasons are taught and suspension lengths are not stated [A07].
Insurance minimums, document expiry windows and collision report thresholds are stated exactly as printed and are flagged as law-variable in the dynamic facts line.
The full document lists and REAL ID rules live on DMV websites that were not fetched in this pass.

corpus_stability.reason: The Oregon Driver Manual is a two-year edition (the front cover names a two-year span and the back cover carries a single form revision code); fees and office details are sent to the DMV website rather than printed, and nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year.
